text: The Cyclone Reinsurance Pool, administered by the Australian Reinsurance Pool Corporation (ARPC), is a government-backed reinsurance mechanism designed to address the financial risks associated with tropical cyclones and related flood damage in Australia. It allows primary insurers to transfer cyclone-related risks to ARPC, supported by a A$10 billion Commonwealth guarantee. The pool aims to reduce reinsurance costs for high-risk properties, thereby lowering premiums for policyholders in cyclone-prone areas.
